research.title: Visual Surface Defect Classification with Texture Features
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking label consistency, removing duplicate samples, and organizing training and evaluation splits by source object.
Implemented a baseline classifier using local binary pattern features and a support vector machine, then inspected confusion patterns across defect categories.

research.title: Baseline Recognition of Indoor Scene Categories
bullets: Organized indoor scene images into predefined categories, checked unreadable files, and applied consistent resizing for the supplied evaluation protocol.
Implemented a nearest neighbor baseline using color histograms, and reviewed misclassified images to document ambiguities between visually similar scene categories.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming delivery quantities against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed unresolved items to the responsible staff for follow-up.
Maintained order paperwork, organized stockroom supplies, and prepared routine handover notes covering pending requests and outstanding delivery issues.

projects.title: Handwritten Digit Recognition with Linear Classifiers
bullets: Implemented a logistic regression baseline for handwritten digit classification using normalized grayscale pixel features and a prescribed training split.
Compared predictions with reference labels using a confusion matrix, and inspected representative errors involving ambiguous strokes and off-center digits.
